name: Extincteur VR
summary:
Extincteur VR, a virtual reality fire simulation software, innovatively trains on managing incipient fires. Developed with the expertise of the French Fab and in collaboration with risk prevention experts, this simulator uses connected extinguishers for realistic learning. It includes a wide diversity of scenarios, adapted to different workplace environments such as factories and healthcare centers, allowing trainees to learn the selection and proper use of extinguishers according to the type of fire.
